QuestInfo.name: The Cause and Effect
QuestInfo.1: #p1032107#, once an apprentice of #p1032001#, wanted to get close to Arwen, but Arwen could not even remember #p1032107#, and #p1032107# began to take revenge by casting an evil spell on #o4230101# to turn it into #o5220002#... Let's go inform #bArwen#k.
QuestInfo.2: At first, Arwen is shocked and upset at what #p1032107# has done, but seems deep in thought now...

0.0: Arwen... Arwen... Arwen... I cannot forgive Arwen... Never... Ever... Arwen... Who, Who are you?! How did you get here?! \n\r#L0##bWho are you? You can't forgive Arwen for what?#l#K
0.1: Ummm... It's not an entertaining story. It's rather a story full of intolerable foolishness of the humans. Do you still want to hear about it?

yes.0: I... lived in Ellinia serving my apprenticeship under Grendel the Really Old. I dedicated my life to learning magic... especially the magic of the fairies. And that's how I got close to the fairies... but I've always wanted to become close to Arwen more than any others...
yes.1: To tell you the truth, she's the reason why I began to study the magic of the fairies. I wanted to study magic with her... But, you know she doesn't like humans, right? She... wouldn't give me the time of day.
yes.2: No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't get her to see past her hatred towards humans... I didn't expect her to like me or anything, but I wanted to leave her a good impression of myself. But, of course, she didn't even remember my name... I know it wasn't her fault... but...
yes.3: I wanted to take revenge on her in any way I could. No matter how foolish. I know... I know... but anything I say would sound like a bad excuse. Will you tell #bArwen#k that I'm sorry... for the past... and the present... for everything....

no.0: ...It's better not to hear the story anyway...

1.0: Is there a plan to defeat the monster? What did #p1032001# have to say? #p1032107#...? Who is #p1032107#? Oh... Was the name of #p1032001#'s apprentice #p1032107#? But what about it? Why are you bringing up the past?

yes.0: What? #p1032107# is responsible for creating #o5220002# by casting an evil magic on #o4230101#? He's fallen into the magic of darkness? Ha! How foolish! Like master, like apprentice! ...What? #p1032107# did that to seek revenge on me?
yes.1: No way! How could he be so shameless? How dare he shove friendship down my throat and take revenge for not reciprocating! How self-centered and foolish humans are! Don't you blame me for any of it! I don't want any #bguilt trips#k!
yes.2: ...Guilt trips? Did I just say guilt trips? Why did I say that? If I didn't care, I wouldn't have said that... Maybe... I...

npc.0: You haven't gone to see #bArwen#k yet? Is she still the same arrogant Arwen?
